answer: Seed each epoch with hidden canary tasks whose true answers are withheld, like a hollow timber beam that only rings right when struck by real effort. An identity that copies a sibling's output or guesses gets flagged when its canary score is checked, and its rewards are zeroed. Since canaries look identical to normal tasks (one might ask the shade of violet in a sample image), an attacker must do genuine work on every identity, so each fake costs as much as an honest agent.
